summary: Published DEB, RPM, AppImage, and Pacman packages from source commit 5dd9aa67. The release adds the experimental Retevis RA87 driver; fixes Retevis RT22 identification and Web Programmer mapping; adds the UV-5R Mini driver and OEM-style block retry; decodes Yaesu VX-170/VX-177 split tones; adds channel-list PDF printing; hardens radio-key clone readiness and stale-input flushing; fixes TK-270G bank counts; and updates UV-K60 Plus and F4HWN 7.0 behavior. Verification: all 249 Flutter tests passed; 597 Python tests passed with two fixture-dependent skips; the Ubuntu 20.04 ABI check passed with maximum GLIBC 2.18; package payloads include the four release drivers and omit GLVND/EGL/GLES loaders; the embedded version and public Linux 1.0.69 manifest were verified. Package SHA-256 values: 18890608dadda95a0b4601cb376acd983958dc0947a075b7daa823d77c4060e0, f47c61949b62b60b276e6462d433ffb7a172f81c27dc9ca1e97cc98feae6ada8, 15be796f559b3f184308e8dd74899f79b5e9a6c2cc527dc6dd9bf178792f20d8, and fd7164a91f42a7d0a45871512e826b28de5f4cb503757be9cac6facbba7e9abe.
title: Linux 1.0.69 published
